sources.note: posteriordb 28f8d3d programs copied by WP50; data copied alongside

acceptance.A1_imports: neither model DLL (sblrc, arK) nor the private tbb.dll imports libwinpthread-1.dll, libgcc_s_seh-1.dll or libstdc++-6.dll (objdump -p); the tool hard-fails otherwise
acceptance.A2_exports: each static model DLL's export-name list equals its dynamic WP50 counterpart; the private tbb.dll exports every stock tbb.dll export (extras reported; target zero)
acceptance.A3_parity: log density and gradient at 64 deterministic positions (numpy default_rng(50700000), N(0,1)) are bit-identical between static and dynamic builds of each model, each evaluated in its own process with its own tbb.dll
acceptance.A4_load: in the static-build parity process no libwinpthread-1/libgcc_s_seh-1/libstdc++-6 module is mapped and tbb.dll is the private one
acceptance.fallback: if A1 cannot be met, fall back to pinning an explicit DLL search path (SetDefaultDllDirectories/AddDllDirectory) to one runtime set, say so, and re-preregister

phase_b.code_path: resident model/preload DLLs, scoped joined sampler pools, ReplicatedStanTarget with 4 truly concurrent replica modules on Windows (no owned worker; unserialised multi-worker)

launcher.name: powershell
launcher.environment: registry Machine;User PATH (WinLibs bin resolves the mingw runtime), Git Bash variables removed

phase_b.launch_dir: build/child/arms/plain holds only the child exe; no runtime DLL beside it

static_long.role: gate: static-runtime DLLs in the reproducing configuration

control_long.role: concurrent positive control: old dynamic DLLs, same cell, same shape

static_short.role: coordinator arm 'static without owned-worker serialisation' at the WP50B shape (see PREREGISTRATION B.3)

control_short.role: supplementary dynamic control at the WP50B shape (WP50B powershell/winlibs-equivalent cell)

phase_b.runtime_expectation_semantics: null = module not mapped in the child after load; a path = mapped module's full path starts with it (case-insensitive); checked per child from the load/after heartbeat
phase_b.ordering: 60 blocks; block b (0-based) = [static_long x5 (seeds first+5b..5b+4), control_long, static_short, control_short] rotated left by b mod 8; strictly sequential

classification.fault: launcher timeout, nonzero launcher return code, missing/non-ok raw output, heartbeat sequence != expected, or a correlated Application Error Event 1000 (child PID decimal + exe path) - so hidden exit-0 crash events count
classification.heap_corruption: launcher return code 0xC0000374 or correlated Event 1000 exception code c0000374
classification.manipulation_failure: loaded runtime modules at load/after do not match runtime_expectations for the arm

decision_rule.short_arms: reported descriptively (faults, upper95); static_short 0/60 with control_short >=1 is supporting, not gating
decision_rule.manipulation: any manipulation failure is reported; a child whose modules contradict its arm is still counted in its assigned arm (intention-to-treat) and listed

phase_c.condition: run only if phase_b gate verdict == fix_supported; satisfied under the disclosed time-window event correlation (as-preregistered PID-only correlation gave fix_not_supported via a reused PID)
phase_c.code: payoff/ crate built against this worktree's HEAD sampler and BridgeStan integration (run_phase_c.py build)

arms.serialised: HEAD ReplicatedStanTarget::load(model, [private tbb], data, seed, 4): on Windows one owned worker + process-global native-call lock (current default)
arms.unserialised: study-local target: 4 independently loaded copies of the same static model DLL, each with its own mutex, free-replica dispatch (9edcbac / off-Windows dispatch); libraries resident

phase_c.ordering: models in listed order; for seed index i the arms run in arm_order, reversed when i is odd; strictly sequential
phase_c.assertions: per (model, seed): start-gradient hash (lp + gradient bits at the 4 starts), draws fingerprint (FNV-1a over all retained draw bits), target_calls and draws_observed are identical across arms; any mismatch is reported as a failed assertion

measures.payoff: per (model, seed): serialised sampling wall / unserialised sampling wall (contended, labelled); per-model median of 3
measures.cpu: per-process kernel+user CPU seconds over sampling and whole process (GetProcessTimes); cpu ratio reported
measures.fault: nonzero rc, timeout, missing/non-ok output, or an Event 1000 for the payoff exe

recommendation_rule.change_default: recommend changing the Windows default from the owned worker to unserialised multi-replica dispatch ONLY IF phase B is fix_supported AND static_short has 0 faults AND Phase C has 0 faults AND every assertion holds AND the median wall ratio is >= 1.5 on BOTH models; and then only for static-runtime DLLs (dynamic-runtime DLLs keep the owned worker). Otherwise recommend keeping the owned worker.
recommendation_rule.note: the rule is frozen before Phase C evidence; wall times are contended by other agents' processes

phase_c.seed_check: git grep -w on worktree and main checkout: 0 hits for each seed
